segments.text: Alex Rivera: We are reversing the Docker Compose decision. After benchmarking, the team has decided to migrate to Kubernetes for production orchestration. This supersedes the decision from last sprint.
Kiran Das: Kiran Das will own the Kubernetes cluster setup. The target completion date is September 15th. This is a hard deadline linked to the production launch.
Rahul Verma: The Redis timeout issue has recurred despite our connection pool fix. We are escalating this to a P1 incident. Alex Rivera is assigned to resolve it completely.
Alex Rivera: I accept the Redis P1 assignment. I will implement a circuit breaker pattern and add retry logic. Deadline: September 3rd.
